app.name: PlantBoard
app.updateAvailable: A new version of PlantBoard is ready.

auth.wrongCredentials: Wrong username or password. Check both and try again.
auth.signInFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.locked_one: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minute, or ask the owner to unlock you.
auth.locked_other: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or ask the owner to unlock you.
auth.rateLimited: Too many sign-ins right now. Wait a minute and try again.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

errors.currentRequired: Type your current password (the one you signed in with).
errors.wrongCurrent: The current password is wrong. Type the one you signed in with.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password in both boxes.
errors.same: That is the password you have now. Choose a different one.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the password. Check your connection and try again.

changePassword.myIntro: Type the password you use now, then the new one twice.
changePassword.saved: Password changed. Use the new one next time you sign in.

people.title: People
people.notOwner: Only an owner can manage people.
people.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? They will no longer be able to sign in here.
people.usernameHelp: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen.
people.secretWarning: Give this to the person in private. It won't be shown again.
people.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the password and copy it by hand.

errors.notAuthorized: You can't do that. Only an owner of this plant can manage these people.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is already in use. Choose another.
errors.invalid: Some details aren't valid. Check the name, username and role.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen.

people.alertsHint: Sends a notification to this person's phones when a machine is marked down. They must also turn on notifications on each phone.
people.canEnterLoadOut: Can enter load-out (type the drivers' load sheet)
people.loadOutOff: {{name}} can no longer enter the load-out.
people.shiftsHint: The manager on duty gets tasks, marks trucks loaded and gets washer alarms during these shifts.
people.idleHint: The manager on duty always gets washer idle alarms, even when this is off.
people.levelsHint: Buzz: a notification and the Alerts tab. Quiet: the Alerts tab only. Off: not shown.
people.startPasswordHint: Leave it empty and the app makes one for you. They must change it the first time they sign in.
people.passwordSet: New starting password set for {{name}}. They must change it the first time they sign in.
people.createdWithPassword: Account {{username}} created with the password you typed. They must change it the first time they sign in.
people.buzzHint: Buzz: a notification on their phones. Off: no notification.

errors.notAuthorized: You can't do that with your account. Ask the owner.
errors.validation: The server didn't accept that. Check the values and try again.
errors.queueChanged: Someone changed the queue. It was refreshed. Check it and try again.
errors.statusChanged: That item already changed status. The list was refreshed.
errors.tooLate: Too late to undo. Ask a manager to correct it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes at once. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
errors.machineDown: That washer is marked down. Choose another washer, or mark it back up first.
errors.pinAgain: This entry was not saved. Enter it again.
errors.washerRunning: This washer is still running. Confirm to start another load.
errors.offQueueReason: This start is not the queue's next. Pick a reason and try again.

washroom.noWashroom: No washroom is set up for your plant.
washroom.noWashers: No active washers in this washroom.
washroom.nextFromQueue: From the queue (see Next in queue)
washroom.nextInQueueHint: Any free washer takes the top item. Loads pinned to a washer show on that washer.
washroom.noUnassigned: Nothing waiting for a free washer.

station.pendingCount_one: {{count}} start is waiting to send. It will send when the connection is back.
station.pendingCount_other: {{count}} starts are waiting to send. They will send when the connection is back.
station.title: Washer station
station.notAWasher: This screen is for a washer, and this link doesn't point to one you can use. Open it from the washer board.
station.inactive: This washer is turned off in setup. Starts are disabled.
station.offline: No connection. Starts are saved on this tablet and sent when the connection is back.
station.chooseGroup: Nothing in the queue for this washer. Tap "Other wash group" and choose one.
station.savedNotSent: Saved {{group}} on this tablet. Waiting for the connection to send it.
station.rejected: The start from {{time}} was not recorded.
station.noStorage: This device can't save starts if the page is closed. Keep this page open until the connection is back.
station.rejectTooLate: It reached the server more than 30 minutes late, so it can't be counted. Tell the manager so they can add the load.
station.rejectDown: The washer was marked down at that time. If it really ran, tell the manager.
station.downNoStart: START is off while this washer is down. Mark it back up when it's fixed.
station.startAnotherQ: Start another load anyway? Only if a new load really went in.
station.rejectRunning: The washer was still running, so it wasn't counted. Tap Start anyway only if a new load really went in.
station.offQueueQ: {{next}} is next in the queue. Why start {{chosen}}?
station.offQueueQGeneric: This start is not the queue's next. Why?
station.rejectOffQueue: The queue changed, so this start needs a reason. Tap "Pick a reason".

queue.title: Queue
queue.readOnly: You can see the queue. Only the owner can change it.
queue.noArea: No area is set up for your plant.
queue.confirmCancel: Cancel {{group}}? It stays in the history.

errors.loads: Type a number of loads from 0.01 to 100,000, with up to 2 decimals.

queue.managerNotice: You can see the queue, add rewash, and move loads off a washer that is down. Only the owner can change the order.
queue.dragHelp: Drag the handle to put the work in order, or tap an item for more.
queue.dragNeedsAll: Show All to drag items into order.
queue.rushStaysTop: RUSH items stay above the rest.

dnd.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it. Press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel. RUSH items stay above the rest.
dnd.overNone: {{item}} is not over a place it can go.

machines.title: Machine down / back up
machines.readOnly: Only the owner or a manager can mark a machine down or back up.
machines.confirmUp: Mark {{name}} back up? It can be used again.
machines.detailsHint: Describe the problem, not the person. Up to {{max}} characters. This shows on the washroom screens.
machines.downEffect: Its START button turns off and loads can be moved off it.

errors.details: Describe the problem in the box.
errors.tooLong: Too long. Use at most {{max}} characters.

machines.reportTitle: Report a machine out of service

rewash.title: Add rewash
rewash.intro: Goods sent back by finishing. They go to the end of the queue.
rewash.noFactor: No load conversion for this group yet; it will be counted by hand.

errors.amount: Type an amount from 0.01 to 100,000, with up to 2 decimals.

estimates.title: Dirty work
estimates.intro: For each wash group, say how much dirty work is waiting. Review, then save them all at once.
estimates.notAllowed: Only the owner and managers enter estimates.
estimates.totalHours_one: ≈ {{time}} of washer time on {{count}} working washer
estimates.totalHours_other: ≈ {{time}} of washer time spread over {{count}} working washers
estimates.noWashers: No working washers right now, so no washer time.
estimates.unknownGroups_one: {{count}} group has no load number set and isn't counted.
estimates.unknownGroups_other: {{count}} groups have no load number set and aren't counted.
estimates.waitingToSend_one: {{count}} estimate is saved on this phone and will send when the connection is back.
estimates.waitingToSend_other: {{count}} estimates are saved on this phone and will send when the connection is back.
estimates.offline: No connection. You can still save: estimates stay on this phone and send later.
estimates.badAmount: Type a number from 0 to 10,000, with up to 2 decimals.
estimates.savedOnPhone_one: {{count}} estimate is saved on this phone and will send when the connection is back.
estimates.savedOnPhone_other: {{count}} estimates are saved on this phone and will send when the connection is back.
estimates.notStored: This phone couldn't keep the estimates. Keep this page open until the connection is back.

errors.tooOld: It is more than 6 hours old, so the server can't save it. Enter it again.

estimates.noTimeGroups_one: {{count}} group has no washer time set, so the time leaves it out.
estimates.noTimeGroups_other: {{count}} groups have no washer time set, so the time leaves them out.
estimates.allEstimated: Every wash group has an estimate.

signOut.pending_one: {{count}} entry or washer start hasn't been sent yet.
signOut.pending_other: {{count}} entries or washer starts haven't been sent yet.
signOut.cantSendYet: Change your password first to send them. They stay on this device for your account.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.what: Machine down alerts: this phone shows an alert when someone marks a machine down (for example "Washer 4 is down: Water pump").
notifications.iosInstallTitle: Add PlantBoard to your Home Screen first
notifications.iosStep1: In Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
notifications.iosStep3: Open PlantBoard from its Home Screen icon and turn on notifications here.
notifications.iosUpdate: This iPhone needs iOS 16.4 or newer for notifications. Update it in Settings > General > Software Update.
notifications.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Use Chrome on Android, or PlantBoard added to the Home Screen on iPhone.
notifications.deniedTitle: Notifications are blocked for PlantBoard on this phone.
notifications.deniedIphone: iPhone: open Settings > Notifications > PlantBoard and turn on Allow Notifications.
notifications.deniedAndroid: Android: in Chrome, tap the icon left of the address, then Permissions > Notifications > Allow. Then come back here.
notifications.dismissed: Notifications weren't allowed. Tap Turn on and choose Allow.
notifications.saveFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Check the connection and try again.
notifications.offFailed: Couldn't turn off notifications. Check the connection and try again.
notifications.subscribeFailed: This phone couldn't reach its notification service. Check the Wi-Fi or data and try again.

tapAlarm.title: Tap not recorded: tell the owner
tapAlarm.late: It reached the server more than 30 minutes late, so the load wasn't counted.
tapAlarm.stuck_one: Not sent for {{count}} minute. Check the Wi-Fi: after 30 minutes it can't be counted.
tapAlarm.stuck_other: Not sent for {{count}} minutes. Check the Wi-Fi: after 30 minutes it can't be counted.

setup.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change the setup.

machines.title: Setup: machines
machines.name: Name
machines.none: No machines in this area yet.
machines.lockedHint: This machine has history (loads or queue work), so its kind and area are fixed. To change them, deactivate it and add a new machine.
machines.deactivateHint: A deactivated machine disappears from the boards and lists, but its history stays.
machines.loadFactorHint: How big this washer is next to a standard one: 1 = standard, 1.19 = 19% bigger. 0.25 to 4.

reasons.title: Setup: down reasons
reasons.requireDetails: Ask for a description when this reason is picked
reasons.deactivateHint: A deactivated reason is no longer offered; past records keep it.

errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change this.
errors.duplicate: That already exists. Use a different name.
errors.invalid: The server didn't accept that. Check the fields and try again.
errors.machineInUse: This machine has history, so its kind and area can't change. Deactivate it and add a new machine.
errors.labels: Each label must be 1 to 60 characters.
errors.name: Type a name of 1 to 60 characters.
errors.englishLabel: Type the English label (1 to 60 characters).
errors.loadFactor: Type a load factor from 0.25 to 4, with up to 2 decimals (for example 1.19).
errors.loadsPer: Type loads per container as a number above 0 and up to 20, with up to 3 decimals, or leave it blank.
errors.minutes: Type the cycle minutes as a whole number from 1 to 300, or leave it blank.
errors.formulaNo: Type the formula number (1 to 20 characters).
errors.formulaInUse: Active wash groups still use this formula. Give them another formula first.
errors.formulaRetired: That formula is retired. Choose another one.
errors.names: Each name must be 1 to 60 characters.

formulas.title: Setup: formulas
formulas.intro: The washer programs, with the number the washer shows and how long one cycle runs.
formulas.name: Name
formulas.minutesHint: Whole minutes, 1 to 300. Leave blank if not known.
formulas.inUseHint_one: 1 active wash group uses this formula. Give it another formula before retiring this one.
formulas.inUseHint_other: {{count}} active wash groups use this formula. Give them another formula before retiring this one.
formulas.retireHint: A retired formula is no longer offered for wash groups; past loads keep it.

groups.title: Setup: wash groups
groups.formulaHint: The washer program this group runs.
groups.perHint: How many wash loads one full container makes, for example 3 or 0.5. Up to 20. Leave blank if not known: the screens then say "loads unknown".
groups.missingTitle_one: 1 customer group has no loads-per-bin factor
groups.missingTitle_other: {{count}} customer groups have no loads-per-bin factor
groups.missingHint: Their drop-offs show "loads unknown" until you fill in loads per bin.
groups.deactivateHint: A deactivated group is no longer offered for estimates or the queue; past records keep it.

errors.basketNeedsFactor: To allow baskets, fill in loads per basket.
errors.binNeedsFactor: To allow bins, fill in loads per bin.
errors.defaultBasket: Estimates can only start in baskets if baskets are allowed.
errors.defaultBin: Estimates can only start in bins if bins are allowed.

loadOut.copiedNone: Nothing copied from {{from}}: nothing was typed that day, or these boxes are already filled.

mats.title: Mats
mats.noItems: No mat items are set up.

loadOut.copyHint: Copies {{from}}'s quantities into empty boxes. Boxes already filled are kept.
loadOut.noRoutes: No routes load on this day.
loadOut.notAllowed: Only an owner, or a manager the owner allows, can type the load-out.
loadOut.nothingForRoute: Nothing typed for this route yet.
loadOut.onlyOnDuty: Only the manager on duty or an owner can mark it loaded.
loadOut.onlyOnDutyNotice: You can see the load-out. Only the manager on duty (by the shift schedule) or an owner marks routes loaded.

errors.qty: Type a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
errors.special: Type the special item (up to 80 characters).

loadOut.someNotSaved: Some boxes were not saved. Check the red messages.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.sent: Sent. They get a notification now and every 10 minutes until it's done.
tasks.nobodyOnDuty: Nobody is on duty right now. Choose a manager by name.
tasks.namesUnavailable: Manager names can't be loaded right now; you can still send to the manager on duty.
tasks.reminderBanner: You'll get a reminder every 10 minutes until each task is marked done.
tasks.notForYou: Tasks are for owners and managers.
tasks.reminderEvery: Reminder every 10 minutes until it's done.

alerts.unavailable: The alerts list isn't available yet. Alerts still arrive as notifications on this phone (turn them on under More).
alerts.noneEarlier: No other alerts in the last 7 days.

home.title: Home
home.noTiles: All tiles are hidden. Tap Customize to show some.

deliveries.todayManagerHint: The ones saved on this phone today. You can cancel them here.
deliveries.noneTodayPhone: None saved on this phone today.
deliveries.title: Customer deliveries
deliveries.intro: Bins per group as they arrive. Each group goes to the bottom of the queue.
deliveries.notAllowed: Only the owner and managers record deliveries.
deliveries.none: No deliveries in the last 7 days.
deliveries.noCustomers: No customers are set up. Ask the owner.
deliveries.noGroups: This customer has no wash groups yet. Ask the owner.
deliveries.badBins: Use 0 to {{max}}, in quarters (¼, ½, ¾).
deliveries.nothingYet: Add bins to at least one group.
deliveries.sent: Sent to the bottom of the queue.
deliveries.savedOnPhone: Saved on this phone. It will send when the connection is back.
deliveries.notStored: This phone couldn't keep the delivery. Keep this page open until the connection is back.
deliveries.waitingToSend_one: {{count}} delivery is waiting on this phone to send.
deliveries.waitingToSend_other: {{count}} deliveries are waiting on this phone to send.

cancel.question: Cancel this delivery? Its loads that haven't started come off the queue.

problems.tooLong: Too long. Use a shorter password.
problems.tooSimple: Too easy to guess. Don't use repeats or runs like 111111 or 123456.

dash.noEstimates: No estimates yet. Enter them on the Estimates screen.
dash.noTimeList_one: No washer time set for {{names}}: its loads are counted, its time isn't.
dash.noTimeList_other: No washer time set for {{names}}: their loads are counted, their time isn't.
dash.noNumberList_one: No load number set for {{names}}: not counted.
dash.noNumberList_other: No load number set for {{names}}: not counted.
dash.oldEstimates_one: {{count}} estimate is old: check it again
dash.oldEstimates_other: {{count}} estimates are old: check them again

dash.withoutCount_other: {{count}} queue items have no load count.

dash.noFinished: No finished goods entered yet — the finishing entry screen is coming.
dash.offQueueNone: All starts followed the queue today.

dirty.title: Dirty work out there
